label: 03_driver_visibility
command:
nvidia-smi -q -d UTILIZATION,MEMORY,PERFORMANCE,POWER,PIDS
nvidia-smi --query-accounted-apps=pid,gpu_utilization,max_memory_usage --format=csv,noheader
cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version
ls -l /proc/driver/nvidia
if [ -r /proc/driver/nvidia/gpus/0000:38:00.0/information ]; then cat /proc/driver/nvidia/gpus/0000:38:00.0/information; fi
for probe_file in /.dockerenv /run/.containerenv /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max; do if [ -e "$probe_file" ]; then ls -ld "$probe_file"; fi; done
command -v fuser || true
command -v lsof || true
